records.issue_text: Adding a nonexistent username to a group silently succeeds with no error feedback, so the admin never learns the member wasn't added
records.rationale: In Admin::GroupsController#add_members, usernames are split and each is looked up with User.find_by_username; if no user is found, it’s simply skipped (no error collected).
